name: spick-dashboard
description: Shows who is working now (lane, model) above the prompt, and a /spick pane with switches (routing, review, gate, lanes, band), lane totals, local quota and recent turns. The switches shape the per-prompt triage checklist, which carries a keyword Hint line per prompt; the gate sends a hinted verdict the main session kept back once at stop time; everything else is observed only.
